effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` DAI to the vault (safeTransferFrom(caller, this, assets)), using the signer's DAI allowance to the vault.
The vault mints gtDAIcore shares to `receiver`; the number is computed from vault totals after fee accrual (floor rounding).
The vault supplies the DAI to Morpho Blue markets; this moves no further signer assets.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", the DAI amount as 'Deposit asset', a constant 'Share ticker' gtDAIcore, and the share receiver.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many gtDAIcore shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 0: signer receives 169.730449009210529689 gtDAIcore; screen shows only 'Share ticker: gtDAIcore'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share amount or a minimum. A router with a minShares parameter is the only way to bound it.

findings.title: deposit labels the DAI amount 'Deposit asset' and shows the share ticker as a separate field without an amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: label "Deposit asset" (tokenAmount of assets); label "Share ticker" value "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker". Case 0 reader: 'gtDAIcore shares, amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Rename to "Amount to deposit" and "Receive shares" so the receiver line reads as what arrives.

cases.notes: DAI out 194.850055987860832817 matches the screen. gtDAIcore in 169.73 goes to the signer as receiver; the asset and party are shown, the amount is not (computed by the vault).

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` gtDAIcore to `receiver`.
The signer pays DAI to the vault; the amount is computed from vault totals with ceiling rounding and is not in the calldata.
The DAI is taken through the signer's DAI allowance to the vault.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", 'Deposit asset: DAI' as a constant, the exact share amount in gtDAIcore, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much DAI leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` Descriptor shows only `"value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the DAI amount or a maximum; the DAI allowance is the only bound.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays DAI for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`; ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit DAI for vault shares".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns gtDAIcore shares from `owner`; the number is computed with ceiling rounding from vault totals.
When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent by that number of shares.
The vault sends exactly `assets` DAI to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", 'Withdraw exactly' DAI amount, 'To' receiver and 'Owner' of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares the owner burns; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share amount or a maximum.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` gtDAIcore from `owner`.
When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent by `shares`.
The vault sends DAI to `receiver`; the amount is computed with floor rounding from vault totals.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", 'Shares to redeem' in gtDAIcore, 'To' receiver and 'Owner'.

findings.title: redeem never names DAI as the asset the receiver gets, unlike the mint format.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: only `shares` (tokenPath @.to), `receiver`, `owner`. ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` mint format shows `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem shares for DAI".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much DAI the receiver gets; the vault computes it, with no minimum.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the DAI amount or a minimum.
